Thing from the Stars
ACTIONS / Round: 2
Return to the Stars: Before its first action of each round, the Star Thing will use the [SKILL_NUMBER:3] Return to the Stars skill as a free action. Among its effects, this skill will summon as many monsters as possible if the Monster Posture track is not full, including at least one Crystalline Aberration I.
